max_win.title: Max win
max_win.content: The Maximum win amount is limited to {maxWinValue}x play amount. If the total win of a round reaches {maxWinValue}x, the round immediately ends, win is awarded up to the cap and all remaining features are forfeited.

how_to_play.title: How to play
how_to_play.content:
1. Choose your play amount size from the available options.
 2. To start a game round, press the 'Spin' button.
 3. Use the 'Autoplay' button to spin automatically.

how_to_calculate_wins.title: How to calculate wins
content: Wins are determined by symbol combinations on active lines.
Only the highest win per line is awarded.
Malfunction voids all wins and plays.

game_options.title: Game Options
content: Win table – Displays win amount values for each symbol.
Settings – Adjust the volume, and other preferences.
Game features – Detailed explanations of features.
About game - Detailed rules. (you are here).

game_panel.title: Game panel
content: Play amount – Displays the current play amount size applied.
Autoplay – Players can enable Autoplay to spin the reels automatically.
Balance – Displays the player's current balance.
Win Display – Shows the most recent win amount.
Jackpot Plate Progress – Displays the current state of jackpot plates.

additional_information.title: Additional Information
additional_information.content: In the event of a malfunction of the gaming hardware or software, all affected play and win amounts are rendered void, and all affected play amounts are added back to the balance.

feature_1.title: Collector Feature (Base Game)
feature_1.content:
Regular Coins with values 1×, 2×, 3×, 5×, 7×, 10×, 15× can land on Reel 1 and Reel 3.
Collector Coin (no value) can land only on Reel 2.
If a Regular Coin lands without a Collector, nothing happens.
If a Collector lands without Regular Coins, nothing happens.

Collector Win Amount Rules
Coins on reel 1 OR 3 + Collector on reel 2 → Collect Win Amount
Coins on both reel 1 AND 3 + Collector on reel 2 → Trigger Bonus Game

feature_2.title: Bonus Game (Hold & Win)
feature_2.content:
Starts with 3 Re-Spins.
Landing any Regular Coin or Jackpot Coin (Mini, Midi, Major, Grand) resets Re-Spins to 3.
Landing a Collector Coin does not reset Re-Spins.
The Bonus Game ends when no spins remain. 
Entering Bonus Game
All Regular Coins from reels 1 & 3 are collected.
All coins on reels 1 & 3 disappear after collection.
All symbols transform into mini-reels.
Reel Behavior During Bonus Game
Reels 1 & 3:
Can land Regular Coins
Can land Jackpot Coins (Mini, Midi, Major, Grand).
Regular + Jackpot Coins refresh Re-Spins. 
Reel 2:
Can land additional Collector Coins.
 Collector Coins do not refresh Re-Spins. 
Multiple Collectors
All active Collectors collect the full value from every coin.
Collectors do not collect each other.

feature_3.title: Multiplier Frames (Bonus Game)
feature_3.content:
Reels 1 and 3 may land Multiplier Frames.
A frame stays until a coin lands in its position.
When a coin lands on a framed cell:
The multiplier applies to the coin value.
Applies even to Jackpot Coins.
The frame disappears after activation.
Frames vanish if unused by the end of the Bonus Game.

Bonus Game End
When Re-Spins reach zero, the Bonus Game ends.
All collected coin values are summed and awarded.
Filling all 9 positions awards the Grand Jackpot (1000×).
